dataset_info.name: MORPHE Evaluation Benchmark V2
dataset_info.description: Expanded technical dataset with 46 records and 16 frozen benchmark queries designed for measurable structural adaptation evaluation.

modules.name: Mixed Core Topics (Overloaded)
modules.description: Overcrowded module combining Java Object-Oriented Programming and Linear Algebra Mathematics.

records.text: Java supports object-oriented principles including encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism.
Java classes can implement multiple interfaces but can extend only one abstract superclass.
Method overriding allows a subclass in Java to define a specialized version of an inherited method.
Java garbage collector automatically deallocates heap memory occupied by unreferenced objects.
Abstract classes in Java cannot be directly instantiated and define common contracts for derived subclasses.
Java Generics provide compile-time type safety by allowing classes and methods to operate on parameterized types.
Eigenvalues and eigenvectors characterize invariant directional vectors under linear matrix transformations.
Singular Value Decomposition factors any real matrix into left-singular, singular values, and right-singular matrices.
The inner dot product computes vector projection and normalizes to cosine similarity in metric spaces.
Matrix multiplication distributes over addition and is associative but strictly non-commutative in general.
Principal Component Analysis projects high-dimensional data onto orthogonal axes maximizing variance.
Matrix determinants quantify the scaling factor of the transformation on volume spanned by column vectors.

modules.name: Vector Index Structures
modules.description: Approximate nearest neighbors algorithms and vector index structures.

records.text: FAISS provides fast approximate nearest neighbor search using inverted file index and product quantization.
Hierarchical Navigable Small World graphs offer logarithmic time complexity for vector similarity retrieval.
Cosine distance and Euclidean L2 distance are standard distance metrics for comparing dense vector embeddings.
Vector databases index high-dimensional embeddings generated by transformer models for semantic search.
Inverted file index with flat quantization partitions vector space into Voronoi cells to accelerate search.

modules.name: Dense Embedding Search
modules.description: Dense embedding retrieval systems and vector comparison techniques (near-duplicate of Vector Index Structures).

records.text: Dense vector retrieval systems utilize approximate nearest neighbors algorithms to compare query embeddings against documents.
HNSW index structures enable scalable semantic search across millions of dense embedding vectors in sub-linear time.
Product Quantization compresses dense vector representations to reduce memory usage in large-scale vector search engines.
Dense vector retrieval compares high-dimensional semantic vectors using cosine similarity distance thresholds.
Vector similarity search engines query dense embedding vectors generated by encoder neural models.

modules.name: Python Data Engineering
modules.description: Python data processing tools including NumPy and Pandas.

records.text: NumPy provides ndarray objects for efficient vector and matrix computations in Python.
Pandas DataFrames support tabular data manipulation, filtering, aggregation, and time-series operations.
Polars is an ultra-fast columnar DataFrame library implemented in Rust with a Python API.
Vectorized operations in NumPy eliminate explicit Python loops for substantial performance acceleration.
Python classes support object-oriented programming with multiple inheritance, method overriding, and dynamic polymorphism.
Python abstract base classes define blueprint interface contracts and enforce abstract method implementations on subclasses.

modules.name: Machine Learning Pipelines
modules.description: PyTorch deep learning model architectures, training loops, and optimization routines.

records.text: PyTorch tensors support automatic differentiation via autograd for gradient-based neural network optimization.
Cross-entropy loss measures the discrepancy between predicted probability distributions and true categorical labels.
Adam optimizer dynamically adapts learning rates using first and second momentum estimates of gradients.
DataLoaders in PyTorch handle batching, shuffling, and multi-threaded data prefetching for model training.
Backpropagation computes the gradient of the loss function with respect to model parameters via chain rule.
Dropout regularization randomly deactivates neural connections during training to mitigate model overfitting.

modules.name: Relational Databases and SQL
modules.description: Relational database concepts, schema normalization, ACID transactions, and indexing.

records.text: Relational databases enforce ACID guarantees: Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, and Durability.
B-Tree indexes provide logarithmic time lookups for equality and range queries in relational database tables.
Database normalization organizes tables to minimize data redundancy and eliminate update anomalies.
SQL JOIN operations combine rows from two or more tables based on a related common key column.
Foreign key constraints preserve referential integrity between child and parent tables in SQL schemas.
Write-Ahead Logging ensures database transactions can be recovered after power failures or crashes.

modules.name: Distributed Systems
modules.description: Distributed systems fundamentals, consensus algorithms, replication, and partitioning.

records.text: The CAP theorem states a distributed data store can guarantee at most two of Consistency, Availability, Partition tolerance.
Raft consensus algorithm selects a leader to manage replicated state machines across distributed cluster nodes.
Consistent hashing minimizes key remapping when distributed cache nodes are dynamically added or removed.
Two-Phase Commit coordinates atomic transactions across autonomous distributed database nodes.
Gossip protocols disseminate membership state across large peer-to-peer networks with high fault tolerance.
Vector clocks track causality and detect concurrent updates in distributed key-value storage systems.
